svg.title: Polygood Wall Tile groove layout: cat_wave_stack_117x350
svg.desc: Catalogue (Smaragd sample): vertical stack, wavy joints, 116.7 x 350 mm. Units: mm. Lines are tool centrelines; stroke width is the cutter diameter (6.35 mm, 1/4 in single-flute end mill, max 4.0 mm per pass). Groove depth to be confirmed with Polygood. Grooves on the module edge continue into the next module.
